description: This is a test class for the ShelfController in a Java Spring Boot project. It contains unit tests for various endpoints of the ShelfController, including listing shelves, creating, renaming, and deleting shelves, with mock dependencies and assertions to verify correct behavior.

classes.name: ShelfControllerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ShelfController, testing various endpoints and behaviors with mocked services.

methods.name: all_returnsEmptyList_whenNoShelvesExist
methods.description: Tests that the 'all' method returns an empty list when no shelves exist.

methods.name: all_returnsNonEmptyList_whenPredefinedShelvesExist
methods.description: Tests that the 'all' method returns predefined shelves when they exist.

methods.name: all_returnsNonEmptyList_whenUserCreatedShelvesExist
methods.description: Tests that the 'all' method returns user-created shelves when they exist.

methods.name: all_returnsNonCombinedList_whenBothPredefinedAndUserCreatedShelvesExist
methods.description: Tests that the 'all' method returns a combined list of predefined and user-created shelves.

methods.name: create_returnsBadRequest_ifShelfNameTaken
methods.description: Tests that creating a shelf with a name that already exists returns a BAD_REQUEST response.

methods.name: create_throws_ifNoNameOrEmptyNameSpecified
methods.description: Tests that creating a shelf with null or empty name results in BAD_REQUEST.

methods.name: renameShelf_ThrowsIfNoNameOrEmptyNameSpecifiedForLocatingShelf
methods.description: Tests that renaming a shelf with null or empty old name throws a BAD_REQUEST.

methods.name: renameShelf_ThrowsIfNoNameOrEmptyNameSpecifiedForNewName
methods.description: Tests that renaming a shelf with null or empty new name throws a BAD_REQUEST.

methods.name: renameShelf_ThrowsIfUserCreatedShelfDoesNotExist
methods.description: Tests that renaming a non-existent shelf throws a NOT_FOUND error.

methods.name: deleteShelf_returnsBadRequest_ifShelfNameIsBlank
methods.description: Tests that deleting a shelf with blank name returns BAD_REQUEST.

methods.name: deleteShelf_returnsBadRequest_ifUserCreatedShelfDoesNotExist
methods.description: Tests that deleting a non-existent shelf returns NOT_FOUND.
